Competed awards carry option time more often in 8 of 11 departments, by a median
of 1.1 points, from -2.1 to +2.7; the hairline is the 95% interval, about half a
point wide, so a three-point effect could not have hidden here. The same control
on the same awards moves money-ceiling coverage by a median of 11 points. FY2015
USAspending API v2 bulk download, fetched 2026-09-22; FY2016 with FY2015 as the replication. Shares are of the group's own awards. CAVEAT: the competition control is
computed inside each department, so it is not reading the mix of departments; the hairline is a 95% interval. These eleven civilian departments are 8.5% of federal
contract awards; Defense (68.6%) is absent, so this is not federal procurement as a whole.
